_comment_mode: "repo" = docs live in a separate repository (fill in doc_repo, delete local_docs). "local" = docs live in this project repo (fill in local_docs, delete doc_repo). Delete every _comment_* key when writing the real config.

instructions: Dependency version bumps never warrant a doc update unless a documented minimum version changes.
Never edit docs/legal/** or docs/releases/** — those are maintained by hand.
Public API changes always require an update to the reference page for that endpoint.
Match the surrounding page's voice; do not add a changelog entry unless asked.
